title: Cumulative Update Summary for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central (July, 2026)
summary: This post provides release details for the July 2026 Cumulative Update for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, including version numbers and build information for the current and previous release waves, along with support timelines for on-premises deployments across all versions.
key_points: BC28 CU03 is released with version 28.3 for cloud (SaaS) and Update 28.3 for on-premises with specific platform and application build numbers
BC27 receives CU09 and BC26 receives CU15, continuing updates for 2025 release waves
2026 release wave 1 (version 28.x) started April 1, 2026 and will be in support until October 13, 2027
Older versions BC25 through BC13 are marked as end of life, with detailed retirement dates provided
On-premises support follows either Modern Policy (October 1, 2019 onwards, in support) or Fixed Policy (ending October 14, 2025)
features: Managing Production and Sandbox Environments in the Admin Center

quotes.text: Dynamics 365 Business Central on-premises (Modern Policy) follows the Modern Lifecycle Policy
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the support policy applicable to on-premises deployments, affecting long-term maintenance strategies
